title: Sankyo Fever: Jikki Simulation S Vol. 3
native_title: ＳＡＮＫＹＯ ＦＥＶＥＲ 実機シミュレーションＳ Ｖｏｌ．３
overview:
The third entry in the Sankyo Fever S series arrives!!

Features 5 machines old and new: the brand-new "Fever Big Chime" plus the classic "Fever Queen II" and "Fever Powerful III"!

This pachinko simulation recreates real Sankyo machines on your Saturn. Pick a machine from the selection screen, which lists its jackpot odds and other specifications, then play it ball by ball. A data analysis screen tracks your session, including play time, spins, reach frequency and jackpot count. The lineup is rounded out by CR Fever Super Nine JX and one more Fever machine.

- 5 Sankyo pachinko machines
- Machine specs and data analysis screens
- Memory backup
- Supports the pachinko handle controller

SANKYO FEVER Sシリーズ第3弾登場!!

超最新機種「フィーバービッグチャイム」に名機種「フィーバークィーンII」、「フィーバーパワフルIII」と新旧の5機種を搭載!
